lane: B4 paired-flank scarp-step asymmetry (self-assigned; no method paragraph supplied in prompt - irregularity carried from preregistration)
hypothesis: A fault is a signed across-strike step, not a symmetric ridge: paired-flank mean difference (+2..+4px vs -2..-4px along the local normal, 8 orientations) on det_elev/depth_to_basement/iso_grav/RTP catches faults whose scarp crest is eroded but whose step persists, including catalogue-missing segments under thin cover where potential-field steps persist.
mechanism: Normalized-convolution smoothing sigma=1.5; per-band max-over-8-orientations |flank step|; sigma=1.5 persistence smoothing; train-q95 normalisation; fixed weights elev .40 / basement .30 / grav .15 / RTP .15; greedy dotted emission min-sep 2.8px (K2 emitter reused); >2px off-catalogue apron at export; shared gems57-pooled-hide-v2 evaluator, label-blind quadrant whole-component folds, 80px buffer, visible faults masked pixel-exactly.
named_non_fault_mimic: Alluvial-fan terrace risers and Lahontan shoreline benches produce identical elevation steps; lithologic contacts produce gravity/RTP steps.
experiments: E1 b4 vs gradient control at 0.73%/1.10%
